note: The shop signs and logos are their own day textures (2026-11-24): drawn without their glow by day, glowing at night, as the standard has it. Not listed, and lit at every hour: the signals. Every glowing mesh on udp1-allsigns is a traffic-light lens and udp1-msc-red is the emergency lights and the hospital crosses; a builder chooses their state by the tile's loops (a one-second red, the twenty-second cycle), so those loops stay as the set ships them.
